title.zh: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment
title.en: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment

current_state.zh: Binance declined to comment on a WSJ report that ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block its Greek MiCA license bid, while reaffirming its commitment to securing European authorization.
